unify_header.title: SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
unify_header.role_narrative: Led the platform roadmap, core systems architecture, and commercialization of a production-grade generative AI Solution Accelerator within a consulting firm, serving Fortune 500 financial institutions and converting bespoke client delivery into reusable IP deployed across enterprise lines of business.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, establishing L0 route-policy dispatch and runtime proof-bundle lineage as the control-plane foundation for production agentic delivery.
- bul_unify_002: Built CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization, translating partner and customer deal support into repeatable, revenue-linked adoption pathways.
- bul_unify_003: Delivered audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by instituting evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls across the production agent runtime.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks while preserving deterministic auditability.
- bul_unify_005: Architected distributed cloud data runtime integration patterns across Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and API gateways, applying dense sparse exact retrieval design and provider egress governance.
- bul_unify_006: Converted bespoke delivery into commercialized platform IP while scaling the engineering team from 8 to 28, building the operating model behind reusable agentic AI capability.
